title: Laserfiche Advanced Search Syntax 10.3 White Paper, October 2018
findings: Numeric LookIn value is interpreted as folder ID; Subfolders=0/N restricts direct children.
Double quotation marks inside quoted literals are doubled.
Wildcards [, ], ?, backslash and * have backslash escapes.
Indexed ~= syntax doubles apostrophes and backslash-escapes tilde.
applicability_limit: Historical vendor search grammar; combine with current Repository v2 guide/SDK. Basic phrase semantics still require careful mapping and scope-specific synthetic checks.
